ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture there is a grid shape composed of several tilted small squares, and a thick black broken line extends along the edges of these small squares from near the lower left to the right side. Tracing the thick black line segment by segment, it can be seen that it is composed of 9 side lengths of small squares. Reasoning: The area of each small square is 4 cm^2, so the side length is sqrt(4)=2 cm. The thick line length is 9 side lengths, therefore the total length is 9×2=18 cm.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image and trace the thick black polyline from one endpoint to the other. It follows edges of the tilted square grid. Count the number of small-square side-length segments covered by the thick line; the path consists of 9 such unit grid edges. From the text, each square has area 4 cm^2, so each square’s side length is sqrt(4)=2 cm. Multiply 9 by 2 cm to get the thick line length: 18 cm.
